_meta.description: Comprehensive ticket creation template for Progress ServiceNow Employee Center
notes: Each catalog_item has its own set of form fields.
Fields marked required=true must be filled before submission.
Fields with type 'dropdown' have options that are loaded dynamically from ServiceNow -- known values are listed where available.
Fields with type 'reference' are lookup fields that search ServiceNow records (users, cost centers, etc.).
Some fields are conditional and only appear based on other field selections.
All forms support 'Save as Draft' and 'Submit' actions, plus file attachments.

field_types.textarea: Multi-line rich text editor (WYSIWYG: bold, italic, alignment, lists, links, images, code samples)
field_types.reference: ServiceNow reference/lookup field that searches records (has 'Lookup using list' link)
field_types.checkbox_group: Group of checkboxes where one or more must be selected

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: File upload. Available on every form via the 'Add attachments' button.
